fiction_notice: FICTION. Ten invented unresolved observations for UIOWA-18649 preparation. None is a University of Iowa finding. Group names ESS/RIS/IAM are this engagement's fictional services.

observations.decision_informed: whether the two-approval control is operating, is documented-only, or has a standing exception we have not been shown
observations.example_request: the change records for CR-411 through CR-413 including their approval entries, and any standing exception that applies to them

fields.reading_b: only one approval appears on 7 of 12 sampled changes
fields.subject: approvals on standard ESS changes

outcome_map.answer: A documented standing exception covers those seven changes
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Control operates as written, with a scoped exception; finding becomes a validated strength with the exception noted

outcome_map.answer: No exception exists; single approval is the normal practice
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Documented control is not the operating control; finding becomes a policy-versus-practice gap

outcome_map.answer: The sampled records are incomplete and the second approval lives elsewhere
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Evidence-location gap rather than a control gap; request the second system's records

observations.summary: Written two-approval rule vs. one approval on 7 of 12 sampled changes.

observations.decision_informed: whether peer review can be stated as observed practice or must stay attributed to one account
observations.example_request: a merge history export for the RIS reporting repository covering any four-week period, showing reviewer and approval state per change

fields.claim: every RIS change is peer reviewed before merge

outcome_map.answer: A merge history export is available
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Claim moves from attributed to evidenced; strength can be stated directly

outcome_map.answer: No tool record exists because review happens verbally
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Practice is real but unevidenced; finding notes the corroboration limit rather than a gap in the practice

outcome_map.answer: Review is applied to some repositories only
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Scope becomes the finding; request the repository list and its basis

observations.summary: Peer review described in interview only; no tool record supplied.

observations.absence_caveat: Absence in the material supplied to us is not evidence that the review did not happen.
observations.decision_informed: whether the annual review is performed and simply not in the supplied material, or is not currently performed
observations.example_request: the most recent completed access review for one application of your choosing, including its date, reviewer, and the accounts it covered

outcome_map.answer: A completed review exists and can be produced
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Control evidenced; finding becomes a validated strength for the reviewed scope

outcome_map.answer: Reviews happen informally without a retained record
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Practice exists without durable evidence; finding addresses record retention, not the control

outcome_map.answer: No review has been performed in the current cycle
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Gap against the organisation's own standard; becomes a priority finding

observations.summary: Standard requires annual access review; no completed review supplied.

observations.decision_informed: whether the coverage figure we hold still describes the current codebase
observations.example_request: a coverage report generated after the March 2026 migration, from the same tool if it is still in use

outcome_map.answer: A post-migration report exists
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Current figure replaces the stale one; finding states observed coverage

outcome_map.answer: Coverage tooling was not carried through the migration
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Measurement continuity gap; finding addresses the loss of the signal, not the coverage level

outcome_map.answer: The codebase was unchanged by the migration
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Stale report remains applicable; finding records the basis for accepting it

observations.summary: Only coverage report predates the March platform migration.

observations.decision_informed: whether the observed deployment rate can be described as ordinary operation
observations.example_request: the deployment log for a twelve-week period that does not include a freeze, or confirmation of which weeks were frozen

fields.representativeness_concern: two of those weeks fall inside a published change freeze
fields.subject: RIS deployment frequency

outcome_map.answer: A longer log is available
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Rate is measured over a representative window and can be stated

outcome_map.answer: The three weeks are typical; the freeze affected other teams
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Sample accepted with the basis recorded

outcome_map.answer: Longer history is not retained
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Measurement window becomes a stated limitation on the finding, not a performance claim

observations.summary: Deployment log covers three weeks that include a change freeze.

observations.decision_informed: whether the AI-use inventory records zero use or unknown use for this group
observations.example_request: a list of any AI-assisted tools currently in use by anyone on the team, however they were obtained, or confirmation that there are none

fields.practice: the team reports not using AI tools in its work
fields.unclear_boundary: assistants an individual engineer might have adopted without a departmental decision

outcome_map.answer: Nobody uses any such tool
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Inventory records a true zero for this group, which is a finding, not a blank

outcome_map.answer: Some individual use exists outside a departmental decision
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Inventory records informal use; separate from active and planned use

outcome_map.answer: Nobody has asked, so it isn't known
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Stays UNKNOWN in the inventory rather than becoming a zero

observations.summary: 'We don't use AI tools' - unclear whether individually adopted assistants are included.

observations.decision_informed: whether INC-0412 is representative of paging practice or a single-incident exception
observations.example_request: the paging records for INC-0412, and the two most recent severity-1 incidents for comparison

fields.reading_b: 47 minutes elapsed between detection and the page
fields.subject: time to page the on-call engineer for a severity-1 incident

outcome_map.answer: INC-0412 had a known alerting failure since corrected
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Single-incident exception with a completed corrective action; strengthens the follow-through finding

outcome_map.answer: Recent incidents show similar delays
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Paging target is not being met in practice; becomes a priority finding

outcome_map.answer: The timeline records detection later than actual detection
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Timeline-accuracy issue; the finding is about incident record quality

observations.summary: Runbook states a 15-minute page target; INC-0412 shows 47 minutes with no exception recorded.

observations.absence_caveat: Absence in the material supplied to us is not evidence that no inventory exists.
observations.decision_informed: whether data readiness can be assessed at all for this group, or stays unassessed
observations.example_request: the data inventory or catalogue the questionnaire refers to, in whatever form it exists, even a spreadsheet

fields.expected_by: the RIS AI-readiness questionnaire, which refers to one
fields.expected_record: data inventory for the reporting warehouse

outcome_map.answer: An inventory exists in some form
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Data readiness becomes assessable; coverage and freshness can be examined

outcome_map.answer: No inventory exists
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Absence of a data inventory is itself the finding for AI readiness

outcome_map.answer: An inventory exists but is maintained by another department
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Ownership becomes the finding; request routed to the owning group

observations.summary: No data inventory supplied for the reporting warehouse.

observations.decision_informed: whether the review control's scope includes the repositories that carry access configuration
observations.example_request: the list of repositories the review standard applies to, or the setting that enforces it, for one infrastructure repository

fields.practice: code review is mandatory before merge
fields.unclear_boundary: infrastructure and configuration repositories as well as application code

outcome_map.answer: All repositories including infrastructure are covered
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Scope confirmed; strength stated across both code and configuration

outcome_map.answer: Application repositories only
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Scope gap on the repositories that carry access configuration; becomes a specific, actionable finding

outcome_map.answer: It varies by repository and is not centrally set
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Consistency rather than existence is the finding

observations.summary: 'Code review is mandatory' - unclear whether infrastructure config repositories are covered.

observations.decision_informed: whether this is recorded as active departmental use or informal individual experimentation
observations.example_request: the licence or subscription record for that assistant, or confirmation of how it was obtained if there isn't one

fields.claim: an AI coding assistant is in daily use on the ESS team

outcome_map.answer: A departmental licence exists
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Recorded as active use with a known procurement path

outcome_map.answer: Obtained individually with no departmental record
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Recorded as informal experimentation, kept separate from active use

outcome_map.answer: It was trialled and discontinued
outcome_map.resulting_finding: Neither active nor informal; recorded with its end date

observations.summary: One engineer reports daily AI assistant use; no procurement or licence record supplied.
